dimensions.description_en: Broad domain assigned only from the top-level section in which the review cites a work.

dimensions.description_en: Atomic species explicitly named in metadata or citation context. This facet is independent of whether the platform is neutral-atom or trapped-ion.

dimensions.description_en: Hardware modality inferred only from title, abstract, and provider topics to avoid cross-platform contamination from review comparisons.
dimensions.description_zh: 仅由题目、摘要和主题元数据判断硬件模态，避免综述跨平台比较语句造成污染。
